## Analysis
The annealer improved the seed only marginally (1.059793→1.062099), despite nearly exhausting the timeout. The winner retains conspicuous translated blocks, suggesting useful additive structure, but single-element add/delete/swap moves trapped the search behind multi-bit barriers. Thirty-two restarts also left only about five seconds per trajectory, limiting refinement. Thus small-subset search on `[0,80]` is not refuted, but short independent runs and purely local moves are. The best lineage is `sol_0001`.
